criteria.title: Trace short transfers, zero/EOF, interruption, nonblocking retry and delayed errors through a reused read/write adapter while counting actual accepted bytes.
criteria.task: Inject positive partial progress, EINTR, EAGAIN, zero and terminal EIO at each cursor boundary of the retained eight-byte write. Track attempt count and accepted prefix; reject impossible over-reported counts before arithmetic.
